title: Clean Powder Brush
descriptionHtml:
What it is: A universal powder brush for precise application and an ideal companion for Beauty Butter Bronzer (sold separately), delivering a warm, beachy flush of color.

What Else You Need to Know: Luxurious and durable, each brush is handmade in Japan by the most prestigious brush maker in the world, using cruelty-free, super-soft nylon fibers and sustainably sourced birch. Thoughtfully designed shorter handles make for easy, effortless application.
How to Use+
Suggested Usage:
-Sweep the brush in your compact to pick up product, tap once or twice, then apply under the eye and across cheekbones to gauge your desired effect.
-Powder glides on for a buildable and blotch-free finish.
-As always, start slow and build.
-Gently clean brush with mild soap and water.

Gucci Westman’s tip:
-"Brushes are my most important tools. I think of them as an extension of myself, and it’s an absolute luxury to work with an extraordinary brush."—Gucci Westman, Westman Atelier founder
